svg.title: Nguyen translating tridents: connected saddle construction
svg.desc: Three periods of a connected Scherk-based surface with repeated handles. A second view near the periodic direction shows three upper sheets and one lower sheet. This is an illustrative deformation, not a numerical translator.

g.text: Periodic Scherk saddles join the grim-reaper wings to the central sheet
One connected surface · three periods shown
The repeated connections create infinite genus when the strip is continued periodically.
CONSTRUCTION SCHEMATIC · not a solved translator · all visible outer edges are display cuts
